reason: The main thing it does for free is link my bank, and I'm not handing my account data to a brand-new app from one developer that nobody has reviewed. Without the bank link it's just another tracker I have to type into, and I've already quit two or three of those.
objection: I do not want to link my bank account to an unknown app with no reviews. If one solo developer gets hacked or shuts down, what happens to my data?
would_change_my_mind: A friend I trust using it for a few months and showing me it actually filled in their spends on its own, plus real reviews and a clear statement of what data it keeps and who can see it.
